founded: 1990 (claims Sydney origin; Beijing HQ), founder Li Ping 李平
status: active but faded from first tier; sister immigration arm hit by refund scandals; subsidiaries with compliance blacklistings
ownership: Private, founder-controlled (Li Ping); never listed
funding: No disclosed external funding
team_size: Claims 33 branches + 7 overseas offices, '700+ returnee consultants, 1,500+ mentors'; Beijing entity social-insurance headcount only 359 — realistic est. 400-900 actual staff. Basis: baike claims vs 社保 filings
target_dest: AUS-first (historic #1 China market share, tier-1 agent for 39 accredited AU universities), plus UK/US/CA/NZ/EU/Asia
segment: Full funnel (少儿英语 to 移民); Masters significant via Australia/UK volume, but brand is destination-led (AUS) rather than degree-led
pricing: AUS often low/zero-fee (commission-funded); other destinations RMB 20k-60k packages (est., low confidence)
business_model: University-agent model at its purest: deep AU university tier-1 agencies mean commission income funds cheap consulting; plus English training, prep school, study tours, immigration, overseas property
marketing_channels: Baidu SEM, 教育展, WeChat 公众号, branch 小红书/抖音 accounts, legacy TV/portal advertising; '澳际' brand equity in Australia niche
marketing_notes: 2025-26: aging institutional brand living off its Australia association just as AU tightens visas; digital presence undistinguished; no founder IP (Li Ping is honored-figure profile, not content creator). No verifiable follower counts via search. Vulnerable to 小红书-native AU boutiques (e.g. UNILINK-style) eating its exact niche
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 30-80M/yr (low confidence): mid-size SEM + expo spend, far below JJL/EIC
revenue_est: No public data; est. RMB 3-8亿/yr (low confidence)
positioning_en: The Australia specialist that scaled into a generic old-brand agency: first mover on AUS (first agency to partner with the Australian embassy), now trading on 35 years of heritage more than current capability.
positioning_zh: 从澳洲专家做成"万金油"老牌机构：澳洲留学的开创者（第一家与澳使馆合作的中介），如今更多是在吃35年品牌老本，而非当下的服务能力。
problems_en: 澳际移民 (immigration arm) publicly accused of 'irregular operations, slow and difficult refunds' with EIC-style contract traps (Jiemian 2021), dragging the education brand down; Luoyang subsidiary repeatedly on the operating-anomaly list 2021-2025 and placed on the serious-violation blacklist in 2023 — governance sloppiness across the franchise-like branch network; claimed headcounts (700+ consultants) wildly exceed insured staff (359), suggesting inflated marketing claims; Australia visa tightening hits its core commission engine.
problems_zh: 澳际移民被公开报道"违规操作、退费慢退费难"（界面2021），拖累教育主品牌；洛阳子公司2021-2025连年被列经营异常、2023年被列入严重违法企业名单——类加盟分公司网络治理粗放；宣传的"700+海归顾问"与359人的社保参保数严重不符，规模注水；澳洲签证收紧直接冲击其返佣核心引擎。
lessons_en: Copy: the original single-destination authority play — being 'the Australia firm' built a 30-year moat; a boutique should own a destination/segment identity that specific. Avoid: brand dilution into six product lines run at franchise quality; never let claimed headcount/credentials diverge from verifiable reality — corporate registry data is public and clients check.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：最经典的"单一目的地权威"打法——"澳洲=澳际"构筑了30年护城河，精品机构应占领同样精确的目的地/学段心智。需避免：品牌稀释成六大产品线却只有加盟店质量；宣传规模与工商/社保等可查数据脱节——这些信息是公开的，客户会查。
sources: https://www.jiemian.com/article/5812424.html, https://baike.baidu.com/item/澳际教育集团/804926, https://baike.baidu.com/item/洛阳澳际教育咨询有限公司, http://10.ip138.com/liuxuezhongjiejigou/aoji/, https://www.zhihu.com/question/40457011

founded: 2004 (Beijing)
status: active — Beijing-centric mid-large shop, US-grad + Japan focus
ownership: Private (百利天下教育集团); not listed; founder-run
funding: No disclosed external funding
team_size: ~1,000 staff (company claim; two Beijing office sites, 12,000+ sqm — 中国电子大厦 + 中关村SOHO). Basis: company materials/qianmu
target_dest: US-first (esp. graduate school), strong Japan line; also UK/CA/AUS/HK
segment: Masters-first in practice: US graduate applications are the historical core product, wrapped in its '规划式' (planning-style) service system; also UG and Japan
pricing: ~RMB 40k-70k typical US grad packages (a documented complaint cites RMB 60k); Japan lines cheaper (est., medium confidence)
business_model: Centralized Beijing back-office 'assembly line': big telemarketing/SEM front end feeding a large in-house planning + essay team; no big branch network — phone/online national sales instead
marketing_channels: Historically one of the heaviest Baidu SEM spenders in the category; telemarketing follow-up machine; WeChat 公众号 content; 知乎; now 小红书/抖音 accounts and B站 lecture content
marketing_notes: 2025-26: institutional brand, no founder IP. Its model is the purest 'paid-traffic + phone sales' operation among the majors — effective at volume, but produces the classic complaint arc (great pre-sales attention, decaying post-sales service). 一亩三分地 hosts a detailed 2025-era 'avoid Bailitop' thread (RMB 60k, poor service, dragged refund) — meaning its reputation problem now lives on the exact forums US-grad applicants read. No verifiable follower counts via search
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 30-80M/yr (low confidence): sustained SEM dominance requires eight figures annually; ~1,000 staff includes large sales floor
revenue_est: No public data; est. RMB 2-5亿/yr (low confidence, from headcount and package pricing)
positioning_en: The centralized US-grad application factory: no branch sprawl, one big Beijing operation buying national traffic and converting by phone — 'planning-style' service language over an industrialized delivery line.
positioning_zh: 中心化的美研申请工厂：不铺分公司，北京一个大本营买全国流量、电话转化——用"规划式服务"话术包装工业化交付流水线。
problems_en: Documented complaint pattern: RMB 60k packages with terrible delivery and refunds dragged indefinitely (1point3acres); teachers can't attend to each student, generic essays, uneven staff ability, frequent teacher swaps (Zhihu); pre-sales enthusiasm vs post-sales decay is its most repeated review; US-grad concentration exposed to US policy chill; phone-sales model increasingly hated by the 小红书 generation who screen calls.
problems_zh: 投诉画像清晰：6万套餐服务体验极差、退款无限拖延（一亩三分地）；老师顾不过来每个学生、文书平庸、员工水平参差、频繁换老师（知乎）；"签约前热情、签约后失联"是最高频评价；美研集中度受美国政策寒意冲击；电销模式被小红书一代深恶痛绝（直接挂电话）。
lessons_en: Copy: its insight that Masters applicants can be served nationally without physical branches — a boutique can absolutely run remote-first with lower fixed costs. Avoid: everything else — paid-traffic + phone-sales acquisition poisons premium positioning; capacity overselling (more clients than senior staff can serve) is the root of its complaint record; never let the 1point3acres/Zhihu record accumulate unanswered, because US/UK grad applicants read exactly those threads.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：一个洞察——硕士申请完全可以无实体分公司做全国生意，精品机构可以远程优先、压低固定成本。需避免：其余全部——买量+电销获客与高端定位相克；超卖产能（客户数超过资深团队承接力）是其投诉根源；绝不能放任一亩三分地/知乎负评无人回应，因为美英研究生申请人恰恰只看这些帖子。
sources: https://www.1point3acres.com/bbs/thread-1176323-1-1.html, https://www.zhihu.com/question/28208063, https://baike.baidu.com/item/百利天下教育/3107008, http://www.qianmu.org/百利天下留学, https://www.douban.com/group/topic/80922604/

founded: 2000 (Guangzhou)
status: active — top-3 player; 4 failed listing attempts 2015-2018, still private
ownership: Private; founder Li Zhu (李朱) + management + PE fund NLD (bought back control from CVC Capital Partners in 2016). CVC held control 2013-2016
funding: CVC控股投资 2013 (amount undisclosed); 2016 management/NLD buyback from CVC (created ~RMB 4.7B goodwill); failed HK IPO 2015 (target US$300-500M); failed A-share backdoor deals: 四通股份 RMB 4.5B (2016-17), 神州数码 RMB 4.65B (2018)
team_size: ~3,000+ employees; 59-75 branches across 36-43 cities + 7 overseas offices (AUS/UK/CA). Basis: company about-page and baike figures
target_dest: UK/AUS/HK/SG/US/CA/EU/JP — all destinations, historically AUS/UK-strong
segment: Full funnel but Masters-heavy: study-abroad consulting was 75% of revenue (2018 disclosure), and UK/HK/AUS taught-Masters volume is the core; test prep 25%
pricing: Mass-market to mid-premium: UK Masters reportedly ~RMB 10k-15k base tier up to RMB 30k-60k for premium/US grad packages (est., medium confidence)
business_model: Full-service agency + test prep + study tours + annual education exhibitions (启德国际教育展); branch sales network; university commission income on top of client fees
marketing_channels: Annual 《中国留学白皮书》 (industry-standard data report since 2015), large offline education expos, Baidu SEM, WeChat 公众号, 小红书/抖音 branch account matrices, 知乎 institutional accounts
marketing_notes: 2025-26: purely institutional brand (no founder IP; long-time CEO 黄娴 departed 2021). Its White Paper is arguably the best content-marketing asset in the industry — media cite it, giving free authority. Offline expo model aging; digital presence is a many-account matrix chasing 小红书 leads like everyone else. Follower counts not independently verifiable via search
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 150-400M/yr (low confidence): historically sales-expense-heavy (a factor regulators questioned in listing reviews), runs national expos + big SEM spend on ~RMB 1B+ revenue base
revenue_est: RMB 7.8亿 (2014), 9.47亿 (2015), 11.27亿 (2017), 6.05亿 (Jan-Jul 2018); current est. RMB 10-15亿/yr (medium confidence)
valuation: Priced at RMB 4.5-4.65B in 2016-2018 failed deals; no current mark
investors: CVC Capital Partners (exited 2016), NLD (纳合诚投资) and founder consortium
positioning_en: The data-authority mega agency: 'professional, research-driven, international' full-service giant, second tier of trust behind New Oriental, strongest historically in Australia/UK and now HK/SG Masters volume.
positioning_zh: "数据权威型"大机构：以白皮书和展会塑造"专业、研究驱动、国际化"形象的全服务巨头，品牌信任度仅次于新东方，传统强项是澳英，现在主打港新英硕士走量。
problems_en: 黑猫投诉 pattern: '霸王条款' contracts refunding only 10% after zero substantive service (RMB 60k retained); branch managers promise 80% refunds then leave and successors renege; misleading application advice. Structural: 4 failed listings show capital markets doubted its high goodwill, consultant churn and profit durability; heavy fixed branch costs; no founder story or personality in a 小红书 era that rewards people over logos.
problems_zh: 黑猫投诉典型案例：未提供实质服务却按"霸王条款"只退10%（6万服务费被扣）；分公司负责人承诺退80%后离职、继任者不认账；顾问隐瞒申请实情导致多交费。结构性问题：四次上市失败暴露资本市场对其巨额商誉、顾问流失率和持续盈利能力的质疑；重资产分公司成本高；在"认人不认logo"的小红书时代缺乏创始人故事和人格化IP。
lessons_en: Copy: own a proprietary annual data report — EIC's White Paper wins years of free media citations and positions it as the adult in the room; a boutique can do a niche version (e.g. 'UK/HK Masters admissions data report for Chinese applicants'). Avoid: promise-by-individual-manager culture where commitments die with staff departures — put everything in writing at the firm level; avoid refund terms that read as traps.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：做自己的年度数据报告——启德白皮书换来多年免费媒体引用和"行业权威"地位，精品机构完全可以做垂直版（如《中国学生英港硕士申请数据报告》）。需避免：承诺跟着员工走、人走账赖的文化——所有承诺必须落在公司层面的书面文件上；退费条款绝不能写成陷阱。
sources: https://www.eic.org.cn/, https://www.jiemian.com/article/2507673.html (启德上市5年4败), http://www.duozhi.com/company/201702105786.shtml, https://finance.sina.com.cn/roll/2018-10-13/doc-ifxeuwws3700406.shtml, https://tousu.sina.com.cn/company/view/?couid=1311923901, https://www.jiemodui.com/N/122465.html, https://www.eic.org.cn/Report/cn_report_new_2026/

founded: 1996 (Beijing, Renmin Univ. Culture Building HQ)
status: active — small-mid UK-leaning full-service shop with immigration/property sidelines
ownership: Private, founder-controlled (津桥国际集团); not listed
funding: No disclosed external funding
team_size: est. 150-400 staff: ~10 direct-operated city branches (Beijing, Tianjin etc.) + offices in 5 countries. Basis: baike/company site branch counts
target_dest: UK-first, plus US/CA/AUS/EU — 20+ countries incl. HK/MO/TW programs
segment: UK Masters-heavy consulting core, cross-selling immigration, overseas property and language training
pricing: UK Masters est. RMB 12k-30k; US premium packages claim '85% Top-30 admit rate' marketing (est., low confidence)
business_model: Mid-size full-service agency diversified into 移民+海外置业 (higher-ticket items smooth study-abroad cyclicality); MOE/公安部/工商 tri-license heritage pitch
marketing_channels: Baidu SEM, WeChat 公众号, CCTV/portal media features ('16 years zero complaints' claim), expos, modest 小红书/抖音 accounts
marketing_notes: 2025-26: institutional, low-noise brand; leans on regulatory-license heritage and media endorsements — a 2000s trust language that means little to 小红书-era applicants. The immigration/property cross-sell signals where its real margins are. '16年零投诉' is a self-claim contradicted by mixed Zhihu reviews. No verifiable follower counts via search
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 10-30M/yr (low confidence): SEM-led for a 10-branch operation
revenue_est: No public data; est. RMB 1-3亿/yr across study abroad + immigration (low confidence)
positioning_en: Licensed-heritage generalist with a UK tilt: sells 'ministry-approved since 1996' safety plus a one-stop bridge into immigration and overseas property for wealthier families.
positioning_zh: 有牌照情怀、偏英国的综合店：卖"1996年起教育部批准"的安全感，并向较富裕家庭一站式延伸移民和海外置业。
problems_en: Sub-scale in every direction — too small for brand trust, too broad for specialist credibility; Zhihu reviews mixed on consultant quality; 'zero complaints' self-claims undermine credibility; The Paper's coverage of vanishing mid-size agencies ('走到一半的留学路') illustrates the existential risk tier it sits in; immigration cross-sell exposes it to that sector's refund-dispute reputation.
problems_zh: 各方向都不够规模——论品牌信任不如大所，论专业聚焦不如工作室；知乎对顾问水平评价不一；"零投诉"式自夸反伤可信度；澎湃《走到一半的留学路》所描写的中型中介消失潮正是它所处的风险层；移民业务的退费纠纷名声也会反噬留学主业。
lessons_en: Copy: little — but its immigration/property adjacency shows there IS high-ticket wallet share around admissions clients (a boutique can partner rather than build). Avoid: stacking sidelines before the core is defensible; leaning on licenses and old-media endorsements as trust language — modern applicants trust visible casework and named consultants instead.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：不多——但其移民/置业延伸证明申请客户周边确有高客单钱包份额（精品机构可用合作而非自建来吃）。需避免：核心业务尚无护城河就堆副业；用牌照和传统媒体背书当信任语言——现在的申请人只信可见的案例和实名顾问。
sources: https://baike.baidu.com/item/津桥留学/785251, https://www.zhihu.com/question/315059420, https://m.oxbridgedu.org/, https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_3297036, https://www.douban.com/note/543815444/

name_en: IDP Education China / IDP-Noahs (EXTRA — added: foreign-owned giant competing in-category)
name_zh: IDP诺思留学（IDP教育集团中国）
founded: IDP founded 1969 (Australian government origin); entered China 1993; merged with Beijing Noahs (诺思) 2015
status: active but pressured — parent IDP Education (ASX: IEL) suffered severe FY2025 volume declines (student placement down sharply on AUS/CA/UK visa caps; major profit downgrade May 2025 crashed the stock ~50%)
ownership: Wholly owned by IDP Education Ltd (public, ASX: IEL); co-owner of IELTS in many markets with British Council/Cambridge
funding: Parent public company; China ops funded internally
team_size: China: 13 offices in 11 cities (Shanghai HQ); est. 300-800 China staff (basis: office count, liepin presence); global: 100+ offices in 30+ countries
target_dest: AUS-first heritage, plus UK/CA/NZ/US/IE — strongest where it holds formal university representation contracts
segment: UG + Masters mixed; Masters (AUS/UK taught programs) is the China volume core; placement is commission-funded
pricing: Low/zero client fees for represented universities (commission model); paid premium services exist (est., medium confidence)
business_model: Global placement network: official in-country representative for hundreds of AUS/UK/CA universities + IELTS testing ownership creates structural lead flow; counselors on global IDP training standards
marketing_channels: IELTS test-taker funnel (unique moat), idp.cn SEM/SEO, education fairs, WeChat, modest 小红书 presence; global student marketplace app (FastLane/IDP Live)
marketing_notes: 2025-26: institutional multinational brand; its IELTS relationship is the single best top-of-funnel asset in the industry, but Chinese consumers often perceive IDP as 'the Australia pipeline', and its counselors as placement (not strategy) advisers. Anglosphere visa-cap policies (AUS/CA/UK) hammered FY2025 volumes — a warning about commission-model exposure to policy
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 30-100M China (low confidence): fairs + SEM + IELTS co-marketing; global marketing much larger
revenue_est: Parent FY2024 revenue ~A$1.04B group-wide (placement + IELTS); China placement slice undisclosed, est. RMB 2-6亿 (low confidence)
valuation: ASX market cap collapsed from ~A$8B+ (2023) to ~A$1-2B range after 2025 downgrades
investors: ASX public shareholders (Education Australia legacy stake distributed)
positioning_en: The multinational placement machine: official university representative + IELTS owner, selling 'free, official, global-standard' counseling — really a volume channel for its client universities, squeezed hard by 2025 visa-cap politics.
positioning_zh: 跨国投递机器：手握院校官方代理和雅思考试双重身份，卖"免费、官方、全球标准"的咨询——本质是为签约院校输送生源的量贩渠道，2025年被各国签证配额政策重创。
problems_en: Commission model = adviser works for the university, not the student — a conflict boutiques should name explicitly; FY2025 proved its revenue is a leveraged bet on Anglosphere visa policy; counseling depth for competitive US/UK-elite Masters is limited; China ops sub-scale vs domestic giants; brand invisible on 小红书 relative to local players.
problems_zh: 返佣模式=顾问为院校打工而非为学生——精品机构应明确点破这一利益冲突；2025财年证明其营收是对英语国家签证政策的杠杆押注；对竞争激烈的美英顶尖硕士申请咨询深度有限；中国业务规模不敌本土巨头；在小红书上的存在感远弱于本土玩家。
lessons_en: Copy: the structural-funnel idea — own or partner with an upstream touchpoint every applicant must pass (language testing, credential evaluation, school talks); IDP shows how powerful that is. Avoid: revenue models where a third party (universities/visa policy) controls your economics; a boutique charging client-side fees is actually more resilient — say so in marketing.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：结构性漏斗思维——占住或合作每个申请人必经的上游触点（语言考试、学历评估、择校讲座），IDP证明了它的威力。需避免：让第三方（院校/签证政策）掌控你经济模型的收入结构；向客户端收费的精品模式其实更抗风险——这一点应写进营销话术。
sources: https://www.idp.cn/, https://www.idp.cn/special/event/20150806_Idp_Nuosi/, https://www.zhihu.com/question/35597539, IDP Education ASX:IEL FY2025 disclosures/market coverage (May 2025 downgrade), https://m.liepin.com/company/12936401/

name_zh: 嘉华世达（北京嘉华世达国际教育交流有限公司）
founded: 2000-07-19 (first licensed self-funded study-abroad agency in China)
status: active but marginal in B2C — pivoted toward institutional cooperation (university partnerships, exhibitions, Malaysia/Korea programs); its licensing moat evaporated when the State Council abolished agency-license approval in 2017
ownership: State-owned: wholly owned by 中国留学服务中心 (CSCSE, MOE-affiliated 教育部留学服务中心)
funding: State entity; no external funding
team_size: Small core: 41 social-insurance participants at HQ (2023) though 38 branch entities exist (mostly local partnerships); cumulative ~150k students sent. Basis: corporate registry filings/baike
target_dest: Broad but increasingly Belt-and-Road flavored: Malaysia, Korea, plus traditional US/UK/AUS lines; runs CIEET exhibitions
segment: Mixed/project-based: individual agency services shrinking; growing weight on institutional programs (2+2, HND-style pathways, university MOUs) rather than Masters consulting per se
pricing: Historically below private-market rates (state pricing ethos), est. RMB 10k-30k packages (low confidence)
business_model: State-owned service company: agency fees + exhibition/翻译/培训/签证 services + institutional program revenue; brand equity = MOE affiliation ('the official one')
marketing_channels: Government-adjacent channels: CSCSE events, CIEET expo, official website, university MOU announcements; essentially absent from 小红书/抖音 competition
marketing_notes: 2025-26: no meaningful consumer marketing; recent visible activity is delegations (Universiti Malaya 2024, Shinhan Univ Korea 2024, China-Malaysia student-service office 2025). The 'MOE-backed' trust card mattered when licenses were scarce; post-2017 deregulation it competes as just another small shop with a famous parent. Not founder-led, not digital
marketing_budget_est: est. under RMB 10M/yr (low confidence): institutional events only
revenue_est: Small; est. under RMB 1亿/yr (low confidence, from 41-person insured HQ)
positioning_en: The 'official' legacy agency: China's first licensed study-abroad intermediary, owned by the Ministry of Education's service center — a trust brand from the license era now drifting into institutional program brokerage.
positioning_zh: "官方"老字号：中国第一家持牌自费留学中介、教育部留学服务中心全资——牌照时代的信任品牌，如今漂向院校合作项目中介。
problems_en: Its entire moat (scarce official license) was deregulated away in 2017; tiny real staffing (41 insured) vs 38 nominal branches implies franchise-quality variance; state-entity incentives produce no consumer marketing, no digital presence, no premium service culture; mixed Zhihu reviews even in its prime; essentially irrelevant to competitive premium Masters consulting except as a channel partner.
problems_zh: 唯一护城河（稀缺官方牌照）2017年被国务院取消行政审批后清零；实际参保41人对38家挂名分支，加盟质量参差；事业单位式激励导致无消费者营销、无数字化、无高端服务文化；巅峰期知乎口碑也是毁誉参半；对高端硕士咨询市场基本已无竞争意义，更适合作为渠道合作方。
lessons_en: Copy: nothing operationally, but strategically instructive — trust built on regulatory scarcity dies with deregulation; trust built on delivered outcomes doesn't. Also note: its state parentage (CSCSE runs degree verification) means partnership, not rivalry, is the right posture for a boutique. Avoid: resting a brand on an external endorsement you don't control.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：运营上无，但战略上极有启发——建立在监管稀缺性上的信任会随放开而消失，建立在交付结果上的信任不会。另外，其母体（留服中心掌管学历认证）意味着精品机构对它宜合作不宜对抗。需避免：把品牌押在自己控制不了的外部背书上。

founded: 1999 (Beijing)
status: active — still one of the largest by branch count; attempted platform pivot (金吉列大学长, 2020) largely fizzled
ownership: Private; part of 金吉列企业集团 (founder-family controlled; chairman Zhu Yanmin 朱燕民). Never listed
funding: No disclosed external funding; self-funded conglomerate
team_size: ~3,000 staff at claimed peak, 37-52 branches domestic + ~5 overseas; recruitment platforms (猎聘) show 1,000-2,000 band — realistic current est. 1,500-3,000. Basis: jjl.cn, liepin, baike
target_dest: UK/AUS/CA/US/HK/SG/JP/KR/EU — 30+ countries, volume skews UK/AUS/Asia
segment: Full funnel, mass-volume Masters core (UK/AUS taught Masters is the bread and butter); claims 1M+ cumulative cases, 80k+ offers in 3 recent years
pricing: UK Masters ~RMB 13k-15k base (budget tier among majors); premium country packages RMB 30k-80k (est., medium confidence)
business_model: Classic 一级代理 agency: 2,600-3,000 partner universities, commission income + client fees; consultant-sales army in walk-in branches; 2020 'JJL Daxuezhang' S2B2C online knowledge/e-commerce platform attempt to platformize consultants
marketing_channels: Historically China's heaviest traditional advertiser in the category: CCTV, subway/outdoor, Baidu SEM; large offline 留学展; WeChat 公众号; 小红书/抖音/知乎 branch and consultant personal accounts; livestream lead-gen via 大学长 platform
marketing_notes: 2025-26: institutional brand built on ad-volume trust ('27年 old brand'), not founder IP. Pushed consultants to run personal 小红书/抖音 accounts (platformization of sales), which fragments quality control. Notably PR-dependent: paid soft-article 'Top 10 agency' rankings still a staple. Follower counts of official accounts not independently verifiable via search
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 100-300M/yr (low confidence): legacy of massive brand advertising + SEM + thousands-strong commissioned sales force; likely shrinking with margins
revenue_est: No public figures; est. RMB 8-15亿/yr at scale (low confidence, extrapolated from branch count and headcount vs EIC's disclosed economics)
positioning_en: The high-volume 'supermarket' agency: biggest branch footprint, university partnership breadth and old-brand trust for second/third-tier-city families; competes on reach and price, not craft.
positioning_zh: "超市型"走量大所：分公司网点最多、院校合作最广，靠老品牌信任吃下二三线城市家庭；拼的是覆盖和价格，不是精细化服务。
problems_en: Signature complaint: service quality collapses right after contract signing — no service delivered, RMB ~50k stuck, refunds dragged (黑猫/腾讯 coverage since 2021); consultants' credentials allegedly embellished; students churned through multiple consultants amid chaotic handovers; employees complain of low pay, complex hierarchy and burn-out — the turnover directly damages clients. Strategic: budget-tier pricing + commission dependence makes it structurally biased toward partner schools, a trust flaw savvy 小红书-era students now openly discuss.
problems_zh: 标志性投诉：签约收钱后服务断崖——不提供服务、5万元卡着不退、退款拖延（2021年起腾讯/黑猫多次报道）；顾问学历包装造假质疑；顾问频繁离职、学生被多次转手、交接混乱；员工吐槽薪资低、层级复杂、加班严重——人员流失直接伤害客户。战略层面：低价+院校返佣依赖使其天然偏向合作院校推荐，这一利益冲突在小红书时代已被学生公开讨论。
lessons_en: Copy: nothing operationally — but note how durable a 'trusted old brand' aura is in lower-tier cities; brand age itself is an asset worth building early. Avoid: commission-driven school steering (a boutique should be able to say 'we take no university commissions' as a differentiator), consultant handover chaos, and paying for fake ranking soft articles — students now screenshot and mock them.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：运营上几乎没有——但"老品牌"光环在下沉市场极其耐用，品牌资历本身值得尽早积累。需避免：返佣驱动的院校引导（精品机构应能明确承诺"不拿院校返佣"作为差异化）、顾问交接混乱、以及购买假榜单软文——现在的学生会截图群嘲。

name_zh: 立思辰留学（原立思辰留学360）
founded: 2014 (as 叁陆零教育/留学360, Shanghai); acquired 2016 by A-share listco 立思辰 for RMB 344M; current operating entity registered 2017
status: active but retrenched — parent pivoted into 豆神教育 (SZ:300010, 'Doushen', big-language-arts focus); international arm cut registered capital from RMB 10M to 2M in 2023 (retrenchment signal); forced to drop '360' from name after Qihoo 360 trademark suit (2018, RMB 50M claim/asset freeze)
ownership: Member company of Doushen Education group (SZ:300010, formerly 立思辰); public-listco affiliated
funding: Acquired for RMB 344M (2016) by 立思辰; no independent rounds since
team_size: est. 100-400 staff: claims network across 36 cities and 3,000+ partner institutions, but 2023 capital reduction and internet-first model imply lean ops. Basis: baike registry data + company claims
target_dest: 30+ countries — deliberately long-tail: NZ, Ireland, Malaysia, Thailand, Switzerland alongside US/UK/AUS
segment: UG + Masters mixed, volume tilted to lower-ranked/long-tail destinations where university commissions fund 'zero-fee' offers
pricing: 'Zero agency fee' for many partnered universities (commission-funded); paid packages for competitive destinations (est. RMB 10k-30k, low confidence)
business_model: Internet marketplace agency: massive SEO site network (country-specific domains like us.liuxue360.com), online consultant matching, revenue from 800+ signed overseas institution partnerships (commissions) more than client fees
marketing_channels: SEO content farms at scale (its founding DNA), Baidu SEM, WeChat; weibo institutional account; light 小红书 presence; PR awards ('2024 brand influence education group')
marketing_notes: 2025-26: the 2014-era 'internet 留学' disruptor thesis (online + zero-fee) has aged: SEO traffic is dying under 小红书/AI search, and zero-fee commission models steer students to paying partner schools — a conflict boutiques can attack. Institutional brand; founder Luo Cheng's team no longer prominent. Capital reduction in 2023 says the listco is minimizing exposure. No verifiable follower counts via search
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 10-30M/yr (low confidence): mostly content/SEO ops + SEM, no offline network
revenue_est: No recent disclosure; est. under RMB 2亿/yr (low confidence)
valuation: RMB 344M at 2016 acquisition; current value likely far below (2023 capital cut)
positioning_en: The internet-marketplace agency: 'apply online, zero agency fee, 30+ countries' — a volume commission machine for less-selective destinations, living inside a distracted listed parent.
positioning_zh: 互联网平台型中介："在线办理、零中介费、30多国"——面向门槛较低目的地的返佣走量机器，寄居在一个心不在焉的上市母公司里。
problems_en: Zero-fee = commission-steering: only partner schools qualify, so 'free' advice is structurally biased; parent's serial identity crises (立思辰→豆神, K12 pivot, 双减 damage) starve the unit; lost trademark fight forced rebrand and RMB 50M freeze; 2023 capital reduction signals strategic neglect; SEO-farm acquisition model collapsing in the 小红书/AI-search era; thin senior consulting bench for competitive Masters applications.
problems_zh: 零中介费=返佣引导：只有合作院校才"免费"，建议天然带偏向；母公司连环转型（立思辰→豆神、押注大语文、双减重创）令留学板块失血；商标官司败走、被冻结5000万并被迫改名；2023年减资透露战略性放弃倾向；SEO农场获客模式在小红书/AI搜索时代崩解；缺乏能打竞争性硕士申请的资深顾问梯队。
lessons_en: Copy: its early lesson that content at scale captures long-tail search demand — the 2026 equivalent is owning AI-search/小红书 answers for niche queries ('non-JD law Masters HK', etc.). Avoid: 'free' models funded by school commissions if positioning as a client-side premium advisor — disclose incentives loudly; and avoid corporate parents whose strategy changes yearly.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：早年的启示——规模化内容能吃掉长尾搜索需求，2026年的对应做法是占领AI搜索/小红书上细分问题（如"香港法学硕士非法本申请"）的最佳答案。需避免：立志做客户侧高端顾问就不能靠院校返佣做"免费"模式——利益必须高调披露；也要避开战略年年变的母公司。

name_en: New Channel Qiancheng Overseas Study (EXTRA — added: significant test-prep-fed competitor)
founded: 2004 (New Channel group, Beijing, founder Hu Min 胡敏 — ex-New Oriental president, 'father of Chinese IELTS')
status: active — group has 40+ schools/branches and 300+ learning centers; consulting arm (前程留学) riding the group's IELTS funnel
ownership: Private; founder-controlled (Hu Min family/management); early strategic investment from Kaplan reported in the 2000s (later restructured — low confidence detail)
funding: No recent disclosed rounds; group self-funded from cash-rich test-prep business
team_size: Group: 40+ schools, 300+ learning centers, est. 5,000-10,000 group staff; 前程留学 consulting arm est. 300-800 (low confidence). Basis: xhd.cn about-page, baike
target_dest: US/CA/UK/AUS/HK/SG/NZ/IE
segment: Test-prep-first with Masters consulting attached: IELTS/TOEFL students up-sold into UK/HK/AUS Masters applications — the same funnel logic as New Oriental at smaller scale
pricing: Masters consulting est. RMB 20k-50k; bundles with prep courses (est., low confidence)
business_model: Language-training cash engine (its 'core') + consulting up-sell; 'admission officer resources + returnee consultants + foreign editors' pitch; university partnerships incl. joint programs with PKU/Renmin
marketing_channels: 300+ physical learning centers as lead machines, Baidu SEM, 抖音/B站 English-learning content (prep teachers as micro-IPs), WeChat, 小红书 accounts per city school
marketing_notes: 2025-26: founder-led halo (Hu Min books/talks) plus teacher micro-IPs — structurally better suited to short-video era than pure agencies because prep teachers generate daily content naturally. Consulting arm itself is a second-class citizen internally; quality perceived as uneven vs specialist agencies (Zhihu). Follower counts not verified via search
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 100-300M/yr group-wide, of which study-abroad consulting a minor share (low confidence)
revenue_est: Group est. RMB 20-40亿 incl. training; consulting arm est. RMB 1-3亿 (low confidence)
investors: Founder/management; historical Kaplan strategic stake (reported, low confidence)
positioning_en: The 'mini New Oriental': an IELTS-first empire whose consulting arm converts captive prep students into Masters applications — competing on funnel economics, not consulting craft.
positioning_zh: "小新东方"：以雅思为先的培训帝国，其前程留学把自家考培学员转化为硕士申请客户——赢在漏斗经济学，而非咨询手艺。
problems_en: Consulting is subordinate to the training P&L, so senior consulting talent is thin; conversion-driven advising can push clients toward whatever keeps them in the funnel; brand means 'IELTS' not 'admissions' in consumers' minds; same refund/complaint patterns as peers on training courses; founder succession question (Hu Min b.1963).
problems_zh: 咨询板块从属于培训损益表，资深咨询人才储备薄；转化导向的建议可能优先留住学员而非最优申请方案；品牌心智是"雅思"而非"申请"；培训课程端同样存在退费投诉；创始人接班问题（胡敏1963年生）。
lessons_en: Copy: the funnel insight without the conflict — partner with (don't build) IELTS/GMAT tutors for referral flow; and note how teacher micro-IPs make content cheap and constant. Avoid: letting a cash-cow side business define the brand so the consulting arm never earns standalone credibility.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：只取漏斗洞察、不背利益冲突——与雅思/GMAT老师建立转介合作而非自建培训；并学习"老师微IP"如何让内容生产便宜且持续。需避免：让现金牛副业定义品牌，导致咨询业务永远建立不起独立信誉。

hq: Beijing (parent New Channel operates in 40+ Chinese cities)

founded: 2004 (as subsidiary; New Oriental study-abroad services trace to 1996)
status: active — market leader; growth slowing sharply (FY2025 Q4 consulting revenue +8.2% YoY vs +20-31% earlier quarters)
ownership: Subsidiary of New Oriental Education & Technology Group (public: NYSE EDU / HKEX 9901); founder Yu Minhong
funding: No standalone funding; funded by parent. New Oriental FY2025 group revenue US$4.9B; study-abroad consulting est. ~US$700-850M (17% of FY2024 US$4.31B revenue = ~US$733M, grew ~15-20% into FY2025)
team_size: ~2,000+ study-abroad service mentors/consultants (company claim, Jul 2025); 43-55 branch offices in China + overseas offices in London, Sydney, Melbourne, Toronto, Tokyo. Basis: company disclosures/baike
target_dest: US/UK/HK/SG/AUS/CA/EU/JP — all major destinations
segment: K12-PhD full funnel; Masters (esp. UK/HK/SG) is now the volume and growth engine as US demand wavers
pricing: UK Masters: ~RMB 25k-40k service fee + RMB 15-18k third-party costs = ~RMB 40k-58k all-in; US grad packages higher (est. RMB 60k-150k). Mid-premium of mass market
business_model: Full-service agency: application consulting + test prep cross-sell (parent's core), background enhancement, visa, 'full-cycle' services (career planning, cultural adaptation) to raise LTV; branch-based sales force
marketing_channels: Nationwide branch walk-in + school seminars, annual 《中国留学白皮书》 content marketing, 留学展, Baidu SEM, WeChat 公众号 ecosystem, 小红书/抖音 multi-account matrix per city branch, livestreaming leveraging New Oriental teacher IPs
marketing_notes: 2025-26: institutional brand, not founder-led (though Yu Minhong's personal fame + Dongfang Zhenxuan halo feeds top-of-funnel). Runs city-branch account matrices on 小红书/抖音 with private-message lead capture — the model 小红书 itself cites (New Oriental Online) as a lead-gen success case. Exact follower counts per account not independently verifiable via search; presence is broad but engagement is corporate/bland vs boutique studios. Also mining new niches ('银发留学'/senior study tours) as core demand slows
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 400M-1B on study-abroad-related marketing (low confidence): parent group selling & marketing is ~US$600-700M/yr; consulting arm carries huge branch sales headcount + SEM + exhibitions
revenue_est: ~US$700-850M FY2024-25 study-abroad consulting (medium-high confidence, derived from EDU earnings disclosures of segment share and growth rates)
valuation: Not separately valued; parent EDU market cap ~US$7-10B range in 2025
investors: Public shareholders of EDU; no separate investors
positioning_en: The default 'safe big brand' one-stop shop: largest study-abroad consultancy in China, selling trust, scale and test-prep integration to middle-class families across every destination and degree level.
positioning_zh: 全行业默认的"大品牌保险选项"：中国规模最大的留学咨询机构，靠品牌信任、网点规模和考培联动，向中产家庭提供覆盖所有国家、所有学段的一站式服务。
problems_en: Heavy 黑猫投诉 record: refund clauses letting them keep 50% after delivering only an info-collection form or a school list; months-long refund delays; 'store bullies customer' (店大欺客) complaints; sales-driven consultants with high turnover; templated essays at scale; FY2025 Q4 consulting growth collapsed to 8.2% as US policy fears bite and some parents abandon study abroad altogether.
problems_zh: 黑猫投诉量大：只发了一张信息采集表或一份选校方案就按合同扣50%费用、退款拖延数月、"店大欺客"式售后；顾问销售导向、流动率高；规模化生产的模板化文书；2025财年Q4咨询业务增速骤降至8.2%，美国政策不确定性下部分家长直接放弃留学。
lessons_en: Copy: full-cycle LTV thinking (application → career → adaptation) and authoritative annual data reports as trust-building content. Avoid: contract terms that weaponize refund ratios — they generate the complaint record boutiques can position against; and don't let sales incentives own the client relationship. A boutique's pitch writes itself: 'the anti-assembly-line' versus Qiantu's scale.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴："全周期LTV"思路（申请→就业→海外适应）和年度白皮书式权威内容营销建立信任。需避免：把退费比例写成霸王条款——这正是精品机构可以攻击的投诉痛点；也不要让销售激励主导客户关系。精品机构的定位可以直接对标："反流水线"，打新东方规模化的反面。

founded: 1996 (Hangzhou); chairman Ma Yawei 麻亚炜
status: active — East-China regional champion, state-invested, quietly stable
ownership: 浙江新通教育科技股份有限公司; private with state minority investment (国有参股); founder/chairman-led
funding: No public funding rounds disclosed; state-capital participation, terms undisclosed
team_size: Claims 3,000+ full-time staff across 20+ cities globally (company/PR figure; realistic core likely 1,500-3,000). Basis: company about-page and PR profiles
target_dest: UK/AUS/HK/SG/US/EU/JP — full spread; East-China client base
segment: Full funnel: study abroad + 新通外语 language training + international courses; Masters (UK/HK/AUS) is the volume core of the consulting arm
pricing: Mass-market to mid-premium; UK Masters est. RMB 15k-35k, premium US packages higher (est., low confidence)
business_model: Regional integrated ecosystem: test prep feeds consulting feeds visa/settlement; strong government/school channel relationships in Zhejiang (国资 ties); once experimented with '乐学城' education-mall real estate concept
marketing_channels: Dominant offline presence in Zhejiang (branches, school partnerships, expos), Baidu SEM, WeChat, 小红书/抖音 accounts, and conspicuously heavy paid soft-article PR (Sohu/中华网/东方财富 'ranked No.1' advertorials throughout 2025)
marketing_notes: 2025-26: institutional brand; its most visible tactic is advertorial saturation — multiple 2025 paid articles claiming 'No.1 in reputation/service/success rate' with implausible stats (98.8% employment, >50% top-school admits). This buys search-result control but reads as inauthentic to 小红书-native students. No founder IP; no verifiable follower counts via search
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 50-150M/yr (low confidence): regional expos + SEM + visible advertorial volume on ~3,000-staff cost base
revenue_est: No public data; est. RMB 6-12亿/yr including language training (low confidence)
positioning_en: The Zhejiang/East-China incumbent: government-blessed, full-ecosystem regional giant that owns its home market's school relationships and plays a 'trustworthy establishment' card nationally.
positioning_zh: 浙江/华东地头蛇：有国资背书、生态齐全的区域巨头，深耕本地院校关系，对外打"正规军、值得托付"这张牌。
problems_en: Search results are almost entirely self-planted PR — a sign organic reputation is thin; standard mega-agency complaints (consultant churn, templated essays) circulate on Zhihu; regional concentration means national expansion has repeatedly stalled; state-linked governance can slow decision-making; implausible advertised stats (98.8% employment rate) create credibility risk if challenged.
problems_zh: 搜索结果几乎全是自投软文——说明自然口碑单薄；知乎上流传大机构通病（顾问流失、模板文书）；业务高度集中华东，全国化屡屡受阻；国资参股背景下决策偏慢；98.8%就业率这类夸张宣传数据一旦被较真就是信誉风险。
lessons_en: Copy: regional density beats national thinness — Shinyway's Zhejiang school-channel depth generates referral flow money can't buy; a boutique should dominate one city/channel before expanding. Avoid: advertorial-stuffed search results with fantasy statistics — sophisticated Masters applicants cross-check and it destroys trust with exactly the premium clients worth having.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：区域密度胜过全国摊薄——新通在浙江的院校渠道深度带来花钱买不到的转介绍流量；精品机构应先吃透一座城市/一个渠道再扩张。需避免：用幻想数据刷软文霸屏——高端硕士申请人会交叉验证，这恰恰会在最值得服务的客群里摧毁信任。

founded: 2002 (Beijing); founders Shi Lingkong 石凌空 & Li Lifang 李丽芳 (married couple, 50/50)
status: defunct — collapsed Nov 2022: founder went missing (last contact Oct 28, 2022), >RMB 14.23M unrefunded student fees, RMB 1.32M unpaid wages, listed as 失信被执行人 (dishonest judgment debtor) by Haidian court; social accounts stopped updating Nov 2022
ownership: Was private, founder-couple 50/50; never listed
funding: No major disclosed VC funding; self-funded growth
team_size: Peak: ~RMB 5亿 revenue, 14 branches, reported '5,100 staff' (figure from media, likely inflated/includes part-time — treat with caution; core likely 1,000-2,000). Zero social-insurance participants by end. Basis: 163/jiemian/QQ news reports
target_dest: US-first (grad school), plus UK/HK/SG
segment: Masters/PhD-FIRST — the closest historical analog to a scaled 'premium US/UK grad applications' firm; 'Tiandao 6 steps' methodology aimed at top-30 US grad admits
pricing: Was RMB 30k-130k+ per package (single stuck refunds ranged RMB 10k-230k, indicating package sizes)
business_model: Premium grad-school consulting + essay/mentor services; prepaid multi-year packages — the prepayment model became the collapse's fuse
marketing_channels: Was: SEO content empire (massive exam/apply content site), Baidu SEM, 知乎 authority answers, WeChat; weak on short-video era channels
marketing_notes: Cautionary tale, not current player. Built the 2010s' best content-SEO machine for US grad admissions, then failed to transition to 小红书/抖音 era; when COVID cut demand it kept selling prepaid packages to fund operations — a Ponzi-like cash cycle that vaporized. Founder was invisible (no personal brand), so there was no trust anchor when rumors started
marketing_budget_est: n/a (defunct); historically est. RMB 30-100M/yr on SEM+content at peak (low confidence)
revenue_est: Peak ~RMB 5亿/yr (media-reported); 0 now
positioning_en: Was THE premium US graduate-application brand of the 2010s — high-touch, methodology-driven, top-school-focused. Its collapse is the single most instructive event in this category for a Masters-focused boutique.
positioning_zh: 曾是2010年代美国研究生申请第一高端品牌——高接触、方法论驱动、名校导向。它的倒塌是这个类目里对硕士精品机构最有教学意义的一课。
problems_en: Everything terminal: COVID demand shock on a US-heavy book; prepaid packages spent on payroll (salary cuts of 50-80% from 2020, unpaid social insurance); founder vanished leaving 1,400万+ in refunds owed across Beijing/Shanghai/Shenzhen/Sichuan clients; blacklisted by courts; offices seized for unpaid rent. Root causes: no capital buffer, no destination diversification, prepayment dependency, zero transparency when trouble started.
problems_zh: 全是致命伤：美国业务占比过高遭遇疫情需求断崖；预收款被用于发工资（2020年起管理层降薪50-80%、断缴社保）；创始人失联，拖欠京沪深川等地学员退款超1400万、欠薪132万；被法院列为失信被执行人；办公室因欠租被收回。根因：无资本缓冲、无目的地分散、依赖预收款、出事后零透明度。
lessons_en: The single most important 'avoid' case for AcademiaOne: (1) never let prepaid client money become working capital — segregate or milestone-bill; (2) diversify destinations before a policy/pandemic shock forces it; (3) a premium grad-school brand with no founder visibility has no trust anchor in a crisis; (4) when distressed, silence + selling new packages = fraud territory and permanent brand death. Copy only its early strength: deep methodology + content authority for grad applicants.
lessons_zh: 对AcademiaOne最重要的反面教材：(1) 预收款绝不能当运营资金——分账管理或按里程碑收费；(2) 在政策/疫情冲击逼迫之前就要做目的地分散；(3) 高端研究生品牌若创始人不露面，危机时刻毫无信任锚点；(4) 陷入困境后一边沉默一边继续卖新套餐=欺诈边缘+品牌永久死亡。只可借鉴其早年长处：面向研究生申请人的深度方法论+内容权威。

team_size: est. 200-500 staff: ~10 domestic branches (Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, Xi'an, Zhengzhou etc.) + UK/US/AUS offices; ~2,000+ UK students placed/yr. Basis: company site, baike

pricing: UK Masters est. RMB 12k-30k; regarded as relatively expensive for its tier (est., low confidence)

Third-party review platforms put complaint rate ~0.2%/yr (mainly essay-delivery delays and consultant mid-service departures), satisfaction ~4.0/5 — middle-of-pack. No founder IP, no notable social-media innovation; exactly the profile being squeezed between New Oriental's scale and 小红书-native UK boutiques

positioning_en: The steady old UK specialist: 25+ years of UK partnerships and visa know-how, selling reliability to families who want a smaller shop than New Oriental but an older license than a studio.
positioning_zh: 稳健的英国老专门店：25年+英国院校合作与签证经验，卖点是"比新东方小、比工作室老"的可靠感。
problems_en: Essay/document delivery delays and consultants leaving mid-service are its recurring complaints; premium pricing without premium differentiation; stuck in the squeezed middle — no scale advantage, no boutique intimacy, no digital-native acquisition; NEEQ listing brings disclosure burden without capital benefit; UK single-market concentration risk as UK Chinese enrollment fell 23% from its 2021/22 peak.
problems_zh: 文书返稿延迟、顾问中途离职是常年投诉点；收费偏高但差异化不足；被夹在中间——没有大所的规模，没有工作室的贴身感，也没有数字化获客能力；新三板挂牌只添披露负担不带融资好处；英国单一市场集中风险（中国留英人数已较2021/22峰值下降23%）。
lessons_en: Copy: deep, named university relationships (Bristol/York-level partnerships) are real assets a UK-focused boutique should cultivate deliberately and publicize. Avoid: the undifferentiated middle — if you charge above mass-market you must deliver visibly above it (essay turnaround SLAs, named senior consultants who stay); Wiseway shows what slow decline looks like when neither happens.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：有名有姓的深度院校关系（布里斯托/约克级别）是真资产，英国方向的精品机构应有意识地经营并公开展示。需避免：无差异化的中间地带——收费高于大众市场就必须交付明显高于大众的体验（文书返稿SLA、不流动的资深顾问实名制）；威久展示了两样都没有时的缓慢衰退。

funding: Acquired by Puxin Aug 2017 at ~RMB 3亿 annual revenue scale (price undisclosed); no independent rounds
team_size: est. 200-600 staff (low confidence): single-country-origin premium shop, Beijing HQ + several city centers; no reliable public headcount
target_dest: US-first (Top-50 focus), expanded to UK/CA/AUS/HK/SG after 2020 'global' rebrand
segment: US high-school + undergrad-first heritage; Masters/PhD (硕博) a growing secondary line — NOT Masters-first
pricing: Base packages ~RMB 40k+; US Top-50 premium packages with success-based tiered pricing (higher-ranked admit = higher fee), test prep sold alongside (medium confidence)
business_model: High-end US admissions: planning ('留学规划师' model Chen pioneered) + activity/background building + test prep + application, sold as multi-year packages

US-policy chill directly hits its core; the 2020 all-destination rebrand diluted the US-specialist identity. No verifiable follower counts via search
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 10-40M/yr (low confidence): niche premium player, mostly SEM/content, constrained by distressed parent
revenue_est: ~RMB 3亿 at 2017 acquisition; current est. RMB 1.5-3亿 given US demand slump (low confidence)
valuation: Undisclosed at acquisition; parent Puxin's market cap collapsed below US$12M pre-delisting
investors: Puxin Education (roll-up of 50+ brands incl. Global IELTS/环球)
positioning_en: The original US high-end 'planning school': invented the 留学规划师 concept, promising Top-50 outcomes via years of curated activities and test prep — a premium US specialist trapped inside a broke roll-up parent.
positioning_zh: 美国高端申请"规划派"鼻祖：首创"留学规划师"概念，靠多年活动规划+考培承诺美国Top50结果——一个被困在破产重组母公司里的美国高端专门店。
problems_en: Parent Puxin's court-ordered winding-up/debt restructuring (2022) creates existential uncertainty and starves investment; US-only heritage collided with the post-2023 US demand slump, forcing a late 'global' pivot with no UK/HK DNA; roll-up integration damaged the founder-led culture that made it good; success-rate claims (80% Top-50) invite scrutiny; complaints on Zhihu about package upselling of test-prep hours.
problems_zh: 母公司朴新2022年被开曼法院颁令清盘（自称债务重组）带来生存不确定性、投入受限；纯美国基因撞上2023年后美国需求下滑，被迫仓促"全球化"却没有英港积累；被并购整合后创始人文化稀释；"80%进Top50"的宣传经不起推敲；知乎有对捆绑销售考培课时的抱怨。
lessons_en: Copy: the 'planning methodology as IP' move — Chen turned a service into a named, book-published framework that justified premium pricing for years; a boutique should productize and publish its method. Avoid: selling to a roll-up (acquirer distress became the brand's distress); over-concentration in one destination without a hedge — AcademiaOne's multi-destination (UK/HK/SG/US/AUS) spread is the right insurance.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴："方法论IP化"——陈起永把服务变成有名字、出过书的规划体系，多年支撑溢价；精品机构应把自己的方法论产品化、出版化。需避免：卖身并购整合方（母公司暴雷=品牌暴雷）；单一目的地过度集中——AcademiaOne英/港/新/美/澳多线布局正是对的对冲。

status: active (small, aging brand)

funding: None disclosed

team_size: est. 10-40 (basis: single Shanghai operation, workshop cohort model, minimal hiring footprint)

marketing_channels: Word of mouth and alumni referral, 知乎 legacy threads, official site; near-zero paid or social presence
marketing_notes: Essentially no modern funnel: no visible 小红书/抖音 operation, no offer-list machine. Brand survives on 20+ years of alumni goodwill among self-driven MBA/grad applicants. Institutional brand with strong internal philosophy ('help students become better, admissions follow').
marketing_budget_est: est. <RMB 1M/yr: organic/referral only — low confidence
positioning_en: The original 'teach you to fish' application-training house: cohort workshops where students author their own MBA/grad applications — zero ghostwriting, zero guarantees, maximal self-development.
positioning_zh: 留学申请"授人以渔"的鼻祖：工作坊集训模式，学员全程自己完成MBA/研究生申请——不代写、不保录，卖的是成长本身。
problems_en: 1point3acres thread (2016) attacking it as '黑心中介': no native-speaker editors, English editing limited to punctuation/formatting; model demands rare self-driven students, capping the addressable market; brand and web presence visibly aged; tiny scale means no pricing power against modern content-marketing competitors; workshop pedagogy hard to explain in a 小红书-scroll world.
problems_zh: 一亩三分地2016年有"曝光黑心中介"帖：不配native文书编辑、英文修改只到标点格式层面；模式只适合极少数高自驱学员，市场天花板低；品牌与官网明显老化；体量太小，在内容营销时代毫无声量；工作坊教学理念在小红书刷屏语境里很难三句话讲清。
lessons_en: Copy: the workshop/coaching layer is the highest-integrity, lowest-refund-risk revenue in the category (you sell training delivered, not outcomes promised) — a premium boutique can embed a mini-workshop into onboarding to differentiate from ghostwriting shops. Avoid: purity without marketing — BeBeyond proves a superior philosophy with zero funnel becomes a museum piece.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：训练营/教练式服务是本品类里交付最干净、退费风险最低的收入（卖已交付的训练而非承诺的结果）——精品机构可在服务前段嵌入mini工作坊，与代写型机构划清界限。需避免：有理念没获客——BeBeyond证明了再好的哲学，没有流量入口就会变成博物馆展品。

status: active
ownership: Private, founder-owned bootstrapped boutique
funding: None disclosed
revenue_est: est. RMB 10-40M/yr — low confidence
team_size: est. 50-150 (basis: Guangzhou HQ + specialty research-group structure, small-class GRE arm; no insured-headcount data found)
target_dest: US/UK/HK/SG, masters and PhD
segment: Masters-first specialist — markets itself as 'the only national consultancy doing exclusively graduate-degree applications' (pre-dating Compass's similar claim); strong in business/STEM postgrad
pricing: Premium, unpublished; forum consensus '收费比较贵，不冲top学校就浪费钱' — est. RMB 40k-100k by target tier — low confidence

marketing_channels: 知乎 institutional + consultant personal accounts, client testimonial/endorsement letters, offer 榜单, website content; limited 小红书/抖音 investment
marketing_notes: Institutional-professional brand built on named, accountable consultants and verifiable client endorsements rather than volume content; regional gravity in South China; quiet compared with newer social-native players.
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 2-6M/yr: content + testimonial ops, minimal paid — low confidence
positioning_en: South-China premium graduate-applications specialist: program-matched consultants, meet-before-you-sign, and an unusual density of publicly named client endorsements.
positioning_zh: 华南高端研究生申请专门户：按专业分组匹配顾问、签约前可先面谈选人，并以大量实名公开的学员代言作为信任背书。
problems_en: Brand awareness weak outside 华南 and outside 知乎-era channels; premium-only stance shrinks funnel as average tickets fall industry-wide (-12% in 2025); consultant-centric model = talent retention risk (consultants can defect with reputation); aging digital presence; scale too small to absorb the marketing arms race on 小红书.
problems_zh: 品牌影响力出不了华南、出不了知乎时代的渠道；只做高端在全行业客单价下行(-12%)的2025年意味着漏斗收窄；以顾问个人为中心的模式有人才流失风险（顾问带着口碑单飞）；数字化阵地老化；体量太小，卷不动小红书的营销军备竞赛。
lessons_en: The closest structural template to AcademiaOne among the twelve: masters/PhD-only specialization, program-level consultant matching, and meet-the-consultant-before-signing are all directly copyable trust levers that cost nothing; named public client endorsements beat anonymous offer walls. Avoid: their marketing stagnation — a specialist still has to fight for discoverability where applicants search now.
lessons_zh: 十二家中与AcademiaOne结构最像的模板：只做硕博、按专业匹配顾问、签约前面谈选人——这些信任杠杆零成本、可直接复制；实名公开的学员代言远胜匿名offer墙。需避免：它的营销停滞——专门户也必须在申请人现在搜索的地方（小红书）争夺可见度。

status: active — arguably the category's healthiest operator in 2025-26
ownership: Private, bootstrapped (no VC rounds found); founder reported as 张宁 (NTU masters grad) — medium confidence; holds MoE self-funded study-abroad agency qualification
funding: None disclosed; appears self-funded
revenue_est: est. RMB 50-70M/yr (2,656 students in 2025 season x avg ~RMB 20k) — low-medium confidence, based on self-reported volume
team_size: est. 300-600 full-time across 7 cities (basis: 7 offices, all-full-time 3-to-1 delivery model, claimed 300+ expert network on top; active campus hiring in Nanjing)
target_dest: UK/HK/SG-first, plus Australia; deliberately light on US
segment: Masters-first at scale (research-masters volume machine; 2025 season: 2,656 clients, 7,669 offers, claimed 98.2% success, 88% Top-100)
pricing: RMB 18k-24k published masters packages, priced by number of schools/programs; transparent price list, contractual no-hidden-fees (no 名校费/排名费); 12 written service guarantees incl. full refund if any of the 3 assigned staff is not full-time
business_model: All-full-time '3-to-1' (咨询顾问 + 申请主导师 + 文书导师) + proprietary IT: compassedu.hk website/app with program database, 1.16M registered users functioning as top-of-funnel; background-enhancement upsells via 300+ QS100 professor/researcher network
marketing_channels: Own website/app SEO (program-database content moat), 知乎 institutional column + 学员日记 series, 小红书, WeChat 公众号, offer 榜单; almost entirely owned media
marketing_notes: The anti-Valeon playbook: product-led (database/app) acquisition converts DIY researchers into signed clients; content is program data + student diaries rather than founder persona — fully institutional brand. Claims 98% praise rate on 知乎/小红书. Some 黑猫 complaints exist (e.g. alleged exaggerated promises via 小红书 ads, one demanding 50% refund) but volume is low relative to scale.
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 10-25M/yr: large in-house content+IT team, 小红书/知乎 ops, modest paid — low confidence
positioning_en: Transparent, mid-priced, all-full-time masters application factory for UK/HK/SG — published prices, contractual guarantees, and a program-database app that manufactures its own demand at 1M+ registered users.
positioning_zh: 英港新硕士申请的"透明工厂"：明码标价1.8-2.4万、全职三对一、退费条款写进合同，并靠116万注册用户的选校数据库App自造流量。
problems_en: Low price ceiling caps service depth (no elite same-field mentor layer — the 3 staff are process professionals, not PhD peers); 88% 'Top-100' framing masks that volume skews to rankings-driven one-year UK/HK masters, not truly selective programs; Heimao complaints allege 小红书 advertising overpromised outcomes; scale model vulnerable to consultant caseload overload in peak season; almost no US/PhD capability — limited help for research-degree applicants.
problems_zh: 低客单价决定服务深度有限（三位老师是流程专业人员，缺少同领域名校PhD导师层）；"88%进Top100"的话术掩盖了生源集中在排名导向的英港一年硕，而非真正高选择性项目；黑猫有投诉称其小红书广告涉嫌夸大承诺；规模化模式在申请高峰期存在顾问带单过载风险；美国线和博士申请能力薄弱。
lessons_en: Copy: (1) published transparent pricing + written guarantees is a massive trust weapon against an industry of opaque quotes; (2) a program database/content product that serves DIY researchers is the cheapest durable acquisition channel in this category; (3) all-full-time delivery kills the mentor-flakiness complaint class entirely. Avoid: letting transparency force you into the RMB 20k commodity tier — AcademiaOne should pair Compass-style transparency with a genuinely deeper (mentor/PhD) service to defend premium pricing.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：(1)明码标价+书面保障条款，在报价黑箱的行业里是巨大的信任武器；(2)面向DIY人群的选校数据库/内容产品是本品类最便宜且最持久的获客渠道；(3)全职交付直接消灭"导师失联"这一整类投诉。需避免：透明化不等于降价——AcademiaOne应把指南者式的透明和更深的硕博导师服务结合，守住高客单价。

business_model: "Training + mentorship" dual model: full-time in-house counselor (培训师) teaches application strategy, paired with a part-time mentor (名校在读PhD/校友) in the student's target field; founder (龚老师) personally leads school-selection sessions; sells strategy coaching rather than 代办 paperwork
marketing_channels: Campus lectures/posters at Tsinghua/PKU, student campus ambassadors, alumni referral, WeChat 公众号 offer-list posts, Zhihu threads, success-story soft articles (e.g. 从清华到斯坦福)
marketing_notes: Almost zero paid media; growth is ground-game penetration of C9 campuses (教学楼/宿舍 posters, 讲座 with freshmen/sophomores attending) plus 龚老师's personal authority — semi founder-led brand. No significant 小红书/抖音 machine found; follower counts not published. This makes it strong with 清北 students but nearly invisible to 双非/海本 masses
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 2-8M/yr: campus events + content + small team, negligible ad buying — low confidence
positioning_en: The 'elite insiders club' for top-university students applying to US/UK grad school: strategy training and same-field PhD mentors, trading on dominance inside Tsinghua/PKU rather than mass advertising.
positioning_zh: 面向清北复交等顶尖学生的美英名校硕博申请"圈内机构"：以申请策略培训+同领域名校PhD mentor为核心卖点，靠在顶尖高校内部的口碑和讲座渗透，而非大众投放。
problems_en: Notorious 1point3acres thread '血泪控诉世毕盟'; recurring complaints that mentors are unresponsive, give perfunctory 'good to go' feedback, and refuse meetings in peak season; consultants attentive pre-contract then cold after; quality varies wildly by assigned counselor; RMB 80k+ fees for what some describe as 'paying for peace of mind while doing DIY'; founder-gatekeeping (one person doing 选校) is a bottleneck and key-person risk; tiny insured headcount vs. premium price implies heavy reliance on part-time labor.
problems_zh: 一亩三分地有著名的"血泪控诉世毕盟"长帖；高频吐槽包括：mentor不闻不问、文书反馈只有一句"good to go"、申请季约不到人；签约前热情签约后冷淡；服务质量因人而异波动极大；8万+的价格被不少学员形容为"花钱买心安、实际自己DIY"；选校高度依赖龚老师一人，存在瓶颈和关键人风险；参保人数极少，重度依赖兼职mentor。
lessons_en: Copy: owning a narrow beachhead (top campuses) with lectures + peer ambassadors builds a durable premium brand with near-zero ad spend; selling 'strategy training' justifies premium pricing. Avoid: part-time mentors without caseload caps and QC — mentor negligence is the single biggest complaint; a boutique must contractually guarantee mentor response times and audit feedback quality.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：深耕一个窄而高端的滩头阵地（顶尖高校），用讲座+学生大使做零投放的口碑增长；卖"申请策略训练"支撑高客单价。需避免：兼职mentor无接单上限、无质检——mentor怠工是其最大投诉源；精品机构应在合同中承诺mentor响应时效并对反馈质量做抽检。

positioning_zh: 美国线"申请教练"型精品机构：资深顾问人均百余案例、自研申请管理系统实现过程可视化，旗帜鲜明地反保姆式、反代写。
problems_en: Brand reach largely trapped in 知乎 era — thin presence where 2025-26 demand actually browses (小红书); '120 cases per consultant' cuts both ways (experience vs. caseload overload); US-only focus is exposed to 2025-26 US visa/policy headwinds; small scale and key-person dependence; no published pricing or guarantees to counter bigger transparent players.
problems_zh: 品牌声量停留在知乎时代——在2025-26年需求真正聚集的小红书上存在感弱；"人均主刀120案例"是双刃剑（经验足但带单量存疑）；只做美国线，直面2025-26年美国签证与政策逆风；体量小、依赖关键人物；没有公开价格和保障条款，难与透明化的大机构正面竞争。
lessons_en: Copy: 'coach not nanny' positioning language lands well with serious grad applicants — AcademiaOne's durable-business ethos rhymes with it; an application-progress system visible to clients is cheap to build and materially reduces anxiety-driven complaints. Avoid: single-country concentration and letting your content authority stay on yesterday's platform.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴："好教练不是好保姆"的表达对认真做申请的研究生人群非常有效，与AcademiaOne想做长久生意的理念同频；对客户可见的申请进度系统开发成本低，却能显著减少焦虑型投诉。需避免：单一国家押注；内容阵地停在上一代平台不迁移。

positioning_zh: 由"踩过坑的申请人"创立的年轻硕博精品机构：个性化导师式咨询，加上自营的学术科研训练线——先做背景，再拿背景去申请。
problems_en: Tiny scale and near-zero brand awareness outside its long-tail SEO catchment; the paid-research/publication (付费科研) category it upsells faces industry-wide credibility criticism — admissions committees increasingly discount purchased research; key-person dependence; no published pricing/guarantees; growth ceiling without capital or a repeatable social channel.
problems_zh: 体量极小，长尾SEO覆盖之外几乎没有品牌认知；其主推的付费科研/论文发表品类正遭遇全行业的信誉质疑——招生委员会对"买来的科研"越来越打折扣；依赖关键人物；无公开价格与保障条款；没有资本或可复制的社交渠道，增长有天花板。
lessons_en: Copy: long-tail program-level content ('how to apply for X niche masters') wins high-intent grad applicants at near-zero CAC — ideal for a boutique's first 100 clients; landing the funnel on a personal conversation fits premium positioning. Avoid: building revenue on 付费科研-style profile manufacturing — it is the category's next reputational landmine; AcademiaOne should offer genuine academic mentoring with named supervisors or none at all.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：项目级长尾内容（"XX小众硕士怎么申"）能以近乎零成本获取高意向研究生客户——是精品机构拿下前100个客户的理想打法；漏斗终点落在一对一私聊，与高端定位相配。需避免：把营收押在付费科研式的"背景制造"上——那是本品类下一个口碑地雷；AcademiaOne要么提供实名导师的真学术指导，要么干脆不做。

problems_en: Full-funnel breadth dilutes graduate-application craft (masters/PhD is a cross-sell, not a specialism); 消费保 complaint page indicates service disputes exist; heavy fixed cost base (~500 staff, 14 cities) against a shrinking HNW study-abroad wallet; VC-era structure with no disclosed exit path; channel-dependent acquisition means the banks own the client relationship, not the brand.
problems_zh: 全产业链的宽度稀释了硕博申请的专业深度（研究生申请只是交叉销售品）；消费保设有其投诉维权页面，说明服务纠纷存在；约500人、14城的重固定成本对上高净值留学预算收缩；2018年后无新融资、退出路径不明；渠道获客意味着客户关系握在银行手里而非品牌手里。
lessons_en: Copy selectively: partnering with wealth managers/relocation advisors is an underused acquisition channel for premium PhD/Masters clients in the UK context (UK private banks, family offices, corporate mobility). Avoid: full-funnel sprawl — a boutique that tries to serve ages 5-25 loses the sharp edge that justifies premium masters fees; also avoid letting a channel own your client relationships.
lessons_zh: 选择性借鉴：与财富管理机构/家族办公室合作获客，在英国场景下（私行、家办、企业外派）是被低估的高端硕博客源渠道。需避免：全龄段铺摊子——想同时服务5岁到25岁的机构，会失去支撑高价硕士服务的专业锐度；也要避免让渠道方掌握你的客户关系。

positioning_zh: 斯坦福系互联网基因的"多对一"导师制平台：中高端定价、庞大兼职学长学姐导师池、品类内最强的自有内容获客体系之一。

problems_zh: 口碑两极分化；"顾问流动大""催进度心累"是高频吐槽；2018年后再无融资，增长见顶；4000+兼职导师池质检困难（与世毕盟/再来人同样的兼职导师软肋，但客单价更低、毛利更薄）；品牌资产集中在美国线，恰逢美线需求走弱；"2010年洛杉矶创立"与"2014年北京注册"的口径矛盾也反映宣传注水。

positioning_zh: 以"英国本土中介"（伦敦总部、多重英方认证）为核心卖点的中价走量玩家，主打英国G5硕士申请——与AcademiaOne定位重叠度最高的对手，但走规模化低价路线。
problems_en: Zhihu complaints: essay quality poor at base tier (grammar errors, machine-translation feel), extra fees due after offer, no refund if target offers missed; self-review SEO pollutes its own credibility with informed applicants; base-tier price (~RMB 18k) forces assembly-line delivery; 'UK-local' claims outrun the actual London delivery capacity; low complaint volume on Heimao but recurring 'sign-then-downgrade' service pattern in forums.

lessons_en: Highly instructive for AcademiaOne: (1) the 'UK-headquartered' story clearly sells — but PEC monetizes it at commodity prices, leaving the premium 'authentic UK insider' slot open; (2) do not copy their self-review SEO — Masters applicants increasingly cross-check on 小红书/知乎 and punish astroturf; (3) charge one all-inclusive fee — post-offer surprise fees are their most damaging complaint; (4) real UK-side delivery (actual UK academics/admissions insiders on calls) would out-authenticate their claimed 1000-tutor network.
lessons_zh: 对AcademiaOne极具参考价值：(1)"英国总部"的故事确实有效——但优越把它卖成了白菜价，真正高端的"英国本土内行"生态位仍然空着；(2)不要学它的自吹型SEO测评——硕士申请人会在小红书/知乎交叉验证，水军内容会被反噬；(3)一口价全包——offer后加收费用是它最伤口碑的投诉点；(4)拿出真实的英方交付（英国学者/招生内行直接参与咨询）就能在"真实性"上碾压其宣传中的千人导师网络。

lessons_en: Copy: (1) full-time elite talent at top-of-market pay is the honest fix for the part-time-mentor quality problem — clients can tell; (2) a distinctive content voice substitutes for ad budget and is nearly impossible to imitate. Avoid: letting payroll fix your quality but break your margins — a boutique must match talent cost to a defensible price point.

target_dest: US-only (Top-30 focus), UG + Masters

business_model: '5+1' model: five senior consultants per student — incl. two US-side advisors billed as former admissions officers from Top-30 schools — plus three China-side consultants; deep background-enhancement upsells

positioning_zh: 北京典型的"冲美国前30、不成功退款"高端机构：一名学生五位顾问、前招生官背书、10万+客单价，获客靠搜索引擎投放。
problems_en: Self-reported 99% success claims and self-hosted reputation articles undermine credibility with sophisticated buyers; full-refund guarantee creates Valeon-style contingent liabilities; 'former AO' inflation is an industry-wide credibility sore; US-only concentration in a soft US cycle; SEM dependence = rising CAC with no owned-media moat.
problems_zh: 自报99%成功率和自家域名上的"靠谱吗"软文在懂行客户面前反而减分；"不成功全额退款"埋着再来人式的或有负债；"前招生官"人设通胀是全行业信誉痛点；只押美国线撞上需求疲软周期；依赖SEM意味着获客成本只涨不跌、没有自有流量护城河。
lessons_en: Copy cautiously: multi-expert delivery teams (their 5+1) do reassure six-figure-RMB buyers — a boutique version with two named senior experts is enough. Avoid: refund guarantees as the headline promise, self-hosted reputation SEO, and statistical claims you cannot audit — each converts short-term and corrodes long-term, which is the opposite of AcademiaOne's durable-business goal.
lessons_zh: 谨慎借鉴：多专家服务小组（其5+1）确实能安抚十万级客单的买家——精品机构配两位实名资深专家即可达到同效。需避免：把退款保证当头号卖点、在自家域名做口碑软文、给出无法审计的成功率数字——这些短期促单、长期蚀本，与AcademiaOne"做长久生意"的目标背道而驰。

status: defunct — fully ceased operations December 2025 (salary delays from Mar 2025, bonuses cut Jun, bank credit pulled Jul, social insurance lapsed Oct; staff exited en masse)
ownership: VC-backed private company (operating entity 北京华来荣信息技术有限公司); founder 'Alan' marketed on an Oxford-scholar + Morgan Stanley persona
funding: Registered capital USD 14M (2014); two rounds in 2015 and 2017 reported as 'tens of millions USD' total; specific investors not reliably confirmed in public sources
investors: Not reliably confirmed (reported VC rounds 2015/2017; 36kr pitchhub lists project)
revenue_est: peak est. RMB 100-200M/yr; RMB 0 now — low confidence on peak
team_size: Peak est. 200-500 across 3 tier-1 cities (basis: 3 flagship offices + full-time supervisor per student model); wound down to zero by Dec 2025
target_dest: US Top20 + UK G5 focus; also HK/SG
segment: Was UG + Masters/PhD premium; masters was volume core (PG contracts avg RMB 120k)
pricing: UG contracts averaged RMB 180k, postgraduate RMB 120k, largest single contract RMB 420k (huxiu post-mortem reporting)
business_model: Per student: 1 part-time overseas elite mentor + 1 full-time academic supervisor; famous RMB 100k scholarship program as lead-gen; later drifted into 保录-style promises. Unit economics fatal: mentor fees RMB 30-50k/student, total delivery cost RMB 60-70k, gross margin <30%
marketing_channels: Scholarship program PR, brand advertising, tier-1 city sales offices, WeChat content, KOL/媒体 coverage as 'industry disruptor'
marketing_notes: Textbook VC playbook: founder persona ('牛津学霸+摩根精英') + prestige offices + scholarship lead-gen. Industry context that killed it: China outbound students +1.8% to 760k in 2025 but average ticket -12%; registered agencies grew 657 (2020) → 1,143 (2025); CAC +40%. Founder-led brand that could not survive founder-economics.
marketing_budget_est: peak est. RMB 20-50M/yr (scholarships + brand + 3-city sales org) — low confidence
positioning_en: Was the 'industry benchmark' for high-end mentor-model consulting — elite overseas mentors plus full-time supervisors at RMB 120k-420k tickets — until the cost structure and refund liabilities collapsed it in Dec 2025.
positioning_zh: 曾是高端导师制留学的"行业标杆"：海外名校兼职导师+全职学术督导双轨服务，客单价12万-42万；2025年12月因成本结构和退费压力全面停运。
problems_en: Heimao complaints surged 27 (2022) → 186 (2025), concentrated on unfulfilled admission guarantees and refund delays; documented delivery failures (main essay unfinished by November, consultant appearing once a week, mentor perpetually 'travelling on Wall Street', student self-filing applications); wage arrears through 2025; students/parents left unrefunded at closure. Structural: <30% gross margin, high fixed costs, guarantee-driven refund liabilities, rising CAC.
problems_zh: 黑猫投诉从2022年27条激增至2025年186条，集中在"保录承诺未兑现"和"退费拖延"；交付事故有据可查（11月主文书只改了开头、顾问一周露面一次、导师"在华尔街出差"、学生自己熬夜填网申）；2025年全年欠薪；倒闭时大量学员费用无法退回。结构性问题：毛利不足30%、固定成本高、保录带来退费负债、获客成本上涨40%。
lessons_en: The category's defining cautionary tale for AcademiaOne: (1) never sell guarantees you don't control — they become balance-sheet liabilities; (2) part-time celebrity mentors at RMB 30-50k/student destroy margins at any price point; (3) prestige offices in 3 tier-1 cities are vanity fixed costs; (4) collect-now-deliver-later prepayment models die suddenly, not gradually. A boutique should run lean, deliver founder-supervised quality, and price on delivered service, not on promised outcomes.
lessons_zh: 本品类最重要的反面教材：(1)绝不卖自己控制不了的"保录"承诺——它会变成压垮现金流的退费负债；(2)每单3-5万的兼职名师成本在任何客单价下都吃掉毛利；(3)三个一线城市的门面办公室是虚荣型固定成本；(4)预收款模式的死亡是突然的。精品机构应轻资产运营、创始人亲自把控交付质量、按服务定价而非按结果承诺定价。

investors: NEA, Starr Group (史带集团), 涌金集团

business_model: Free-agency (院校返佣) internet platform + deposit mechanics + paid upgrades; smart school-matching app; monetises UK/AUS university recruitment commissions
marketing_channels: SEO/content (中英网 heritage gave a huge organic moat), Baidu SEM, app store, WeChat, industry summits (互联网留学行业峰会), Zhihu threads; institutional brand

positioning_zh: 当年融资最多的"免费互联网留学"平台——主打"让留学更简单"：免费申请英澳院校、App智能选校、以规模讲故事；如今转向办行业峰会、拓展日本线，光环已褪。
problems_en: Textbook case of the 2014-2018 cohort's stalled unit economics: $50M raised against a low-frequency, low-trust-transfer transaction with commission caps per student — CAC never reconciled with LTV. User complaints: deposit refunds made deliberately cumbersome, hidden charges beyond 'free', template essays, contract fine print. The free model steered students to commission-paying (often lower-ranked) partner universities. No exit, no profitable scale; founder attention has visibly moved elsewhere.
problems_zh: 2014-2018融资潮单位经济学失败的教科书案例：融了5000万美元，但留学申请是低频、重信任的交易，每个学生的返佣收入有上限，获客成本始终压不到LTV之下。用户投诉集中在：押金退还流程刁难、"免费"之外暗藏收费项目、文书模板化、合同文字陷阱。免费模式把学生导向有返佣的合作院校（往往排名一般）。最终没有退出、没有盈利规模，创始人的精力已明显转向其他事业。
lessons_en: Copy: their SEO/content moat (中英网 → 51offer) kept the company alive after VC money stopped — a boutique should build owned UK-admissions content that compounds. Avoid: subsidised 'free' as a wedge into a trust business (it attracts price-shoppers, not premium clients); deposit gimmicks that generate refund disputes; raising to a valuation the unit economics can't service.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：中英网到51offer一脉相承的SEO内容护城河，让公司在资本退潮后仍能活着——精品机构应持续沉淀自有的英国申请内容资产。要避免：用补贴出来的"免费"切入一个信任型行业（吸来的是比价客而非高端客）；押金类营销花招必然制造退款纠纷；以及把估值抬到单位经济学撑不住的高度。

positioning_en: Positions as 'top-school mentors, internet prices' — but its market meaning has become the cautionary example of a platform that drifted into guaranteed-admission fraud territory to chase ticket size.
positioning_zh: 对外定位是"名校导师、互联网价格"——但它在市场上的实际意义，已经变成"为了做大客单价而滑向保录取灰产"的反面教材。
problems_en: Investigative reporting (2022) documented staff offering fabricated US undergraduate degrees and RMB 1M+ guaranteed-admission packages; the 2025-publicised lawsuit revealed forged overseas-undergrad application materials for Leeds — and even though the court made the student pay, the judgment text is now permanent public evidence of the practice; mentor-platform core was undifferentiated and copied; Zhihu threads split between shills and scam warnings, destroying signal.
problems_zh: 2022年记者暗访实录其员工兜售伪造美国本科学历、百万级"保录取"套餐；2025年底传播的判决书显示其为申请利兹大学伪造海外本科材料——虽然法院判学生继续付17.6万服务费，但判决全文成了这套操作的永久公开证据；导师平台主业毫无差异化、本就是抄来的；知乎上水军贴与避雷贴齐飞，信任信号彻底失灵。
lessons_en: Avoid, absolutely: any product that promises outcomes you don't control — 'guaranteed admission' economics only work via fraud, and one judgment or exposé outlives every ad. For AcademiaOne: publish a visible ethics/compliance charter (no forged documents, no ghost-written credentials, UK-regulated entity) — in a market poisoned by this behaviour, provable integrity is a paid-for feature.
lessons_zh: 绝对要避免：承诺任何你无法控制的结果——"保录取"的经济账只能靠造假做平，而一份判决书或一篇曝光稿的寿命长过所有广告。对AcademiaOne：公开一份可核验的合规与操守承诺（不造假材料、不代考代写学历背景、英国注册实体受当地监管）——在被这类玩法污染的市场里，可证明的诚信本身就是客户愿意付费的功能。
sources: usaeducations.org 2025-12 judgment analysis, finance.sina.cn/2022-07-23/detail-imizirav5062606, zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/545999177, zhihu.com/question/421830640, zhishiq.com/article_2705.html, admitwrite.com, admitpro.cn/aboutus
revenue_est: est. RMB 5-20M/yr — low confidence

name_zh: 申请方（平方创想教育科技）
hq: Beijing (Tsinghua Science Park)
founded: 2014 (roots in founder's 2009-2010 US PhD-consulting venture)
status: pivoted/shrunk — ToC study-abroad data platform stalled; company (平方创想) now runs B2B/institutional products 方略 (research evaluation) and 学业有方 (gaokao/academic planning); Tracxn records only 13 employees as of Mar 2026
ownership: VC-backed private; founder/CEO 王刚 (Tsinghua dual degree, UNC Kenan-Flagler PhD)
funding: US$5M Series A (June 2016); later strategic round with ATA (Oct 2018); backers incl. TAL 好未来, 明势资本, 海兆资本, 华清策源. Total est. US$8-15M (est.)
investors: TAL (好未来), ATA, 明势资本, 海兆资本, 华清策源
team_size: 13 employees per Tracxn (Mar 2026) — down from est. 50-100 at 2016-18 peak (basis: Tracxn + funding-era press)
target_dest: US-first historically; global university database covered US/UK/EU/Asia
segment: Data/tools platform across UG-PhD; strongest with research-track grad applicants; never a services-first Masters shop
pricing: Freemium: free university/program/case database and tools; paid assessments, courses and (historically) premium consulting
business_model: Big-data 'information infrastructure' for admissions — program library, case library, ranking/assessment tools — intended to monetise via premium tools and B2B data services; ToC monetisation never worked at scale, hence pivot to selling evaluation/data products to institutions
marketing_channels: SEO on program database pages, app stores, WeChat, 知乎; academic-credibility PR (founder's 清华/海归人才 profile); institutional brand with a light founder-expert layer
marketing_notes: 2025-26: minimal consumer marketing; applysquare.com still serves the database, but energy is in B2B (squareedu.com). A cautionary data point rather than an active competitor. Follower counts negligible/not findable.
marketing_budget_est: est. under RMB 1-2M/yr now — essentially no consumer acquisition spend. Low confidence.
positioning_en: 'Data will disintermediate the agency' — an elite-founder tool platform giving applicants the information asymmetry for free; in practice pivoted to B2B education-data services when consumers wouldn't pay for information alone.
positioning_zh: "用数据消灭中介信息差"——精英创始人打造的申请工具与数据库平台，把信息差免费开放给申请者；但消费者不为纯信息付费，最终转向面向机构的教育数据业务（方略、学业有方）。
problems_en: The core lesson of its stall: information is a complement to, not a substitute for, high-stakes advisory — users consumed the free database then bought services elsewhere; freemium conversion was too low to cover data-maintenance costs; TAL-linked funding dried up post-双减; headcount collapsed to ~13. No major consumer complaints — the failure was commercial, not reputational.
problems_zh: 它停滞的核心原因：在高风险决策里，信息只是服务的补充而非替代——用户白嫖完免费数据库，转身去别家买服务；免费增值转化率太低，撑不起数据库的维护成本；双减后好未来系资金收紧；团队缩到约13人。它没有大规模消费者投诉——败在商业模式，不是口碑。
lessons_en: Copy: use rich, well-maintained program/case data as a marketing and credibility layer (AcademiaOne can publish UK/HK/SG program intel that ApplySquare-style users crave) — but always as a funnel into paid advisory, never as the product. Avoid: believing tools/AI alone will win admissions clients; the willingness-to-pay sits in judgment, accountability and hand-holding.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：把详实、持续维护的项目库/案例库作为获客与专业背书的"外层"（AcademiaOne可产出英港新项目情报满足这类DIY用户），但它必须是导向付费咨询的漏斗，绝不能当成产品本身。要避免：迷信工具或AI能独立赢得申请客户——客户真正愿意付费的是判断力、责任兜底和全程陪伴。

name_zh: 芥末留学（大连拓中教育科技）
hq: Dalian, China (offline centres in Beijing/Shanghai/Guangzhou)
status: active — operating and publishing daily in 2025-26; won trade awards 2023-2025 (e.g. Singapore PSB partner award); one of the few 'internet study abroad' survivors that reached profitability
ownership: VC-backed private; parent 大连拓中教育科技股份有限公司
funding: Angel from Xu Xiaoping/ZhenFund-affiliated (徐小平); Series A from 蜂巢资本; Series A+ 数千万元 RMB from 荣瑞基金 (Mar 2019). Total est. RMB 50-150M (est.). Reported profitable since 2017.
investors: 徐小平 (angel), 蜂巢资本, 荣瑞基金
team_size: 300+ incl. ~200 full-time online tutors as of 2019 press; current est. 200-400 (basis: 36kr/Baidu Baike figures + continued national operation; medium-low confidence)
target_dest: Japan-first (语言学校/专门学校/大学院), plus Korea, UK, AUS
segment: Full funnel for Japan (language school → university → grad school); Masters is secondary to the Japan pathway volume business
pricing: Japan language schools: RMB 0 agency fee (school commissions); paid online application packages ~RMB 20k average ticket (2019 data); UK/AUS/Korea packages priced conventionally
business_model: Hybrid: free-agency 返佣 on Japanese language schools (openly explains that schools pay recruitment fees, students pay nothing) + paid consulting up the value chain + post-arrival services (housing, jobs). The rebate model works in Japan because commissions are high relative to service cost.
marketing_channels: Baidu SEM/SEO, app (App Store/应用宝), WeChat 公众号, B站/小红书 content on Japan study, daily news content on jiemo.net; institutional brand
marketing_notes: 2025-26 tactics: daily '留学资讯' SEO posts, transparent explainer content about how the 0-agency-fee commission model works (pre-empting the '免费是陷阱吗' objection — smart trust marketing), app-led conversion. No founder personal brand. Specific follower counts not findable; presence is solid in the Japan vertical, thin elsewhere.
marketing_budget_est: est. RMB 10-30M/yr: SEM + app installs + content team across a national Japan-focused funnel. Low confidence.
positioning_en: China's leading online Japan-study platform — free language-school placement funded by school commissions, transparent about the model, with a full Japan pathway (study → housing → jobs) and profitable niche focus.
positioning_zh: 国内头部的日本留学互联网平台——语言学校零中介费（院校付招生费、对学生免费且模式公开透明），打通"申请—住宿—就业"的日本全链条，靠垂直聚焦实现盈利。
problems_en: Complaints centre on post-arrival Japan services falling short of promises and on advisor bandwidth at volume; the free tier's economics depend on Japanese language-school commissions, so advisors have incentive to route students into partner schools; low ARPU caps its ability to serve premium clients; brand has little authority outside Japan/Korea, so its UK/AUS lines compete with no differentiation.
problems_zh: 投诉主要集中在日本落地服务与宣传不符、旺季顾问精力不足；免费层的经济模型依赖日本语言学校返佣，顾问有动机把学生导入合作校；客单价低，难以承接高端客户；品牌权威性局限在日韩，英澳业务毫无差异化竞争力。
lessons_en: Copy: ruthless destination focus — Jiemo survived the cohort by owning one corridor (Japan) where the rebate economics genuinely work, and by explaining its money model openly (transparency as marketing). Avoid: assuming that model transfers to UK/HK/SG Masters — commissions there don't cover premium service costs, which is exactly why AcademiaOne's paid-boutique lane is defensible.
lessons_zh: 可借鉴：极致的目的地聚焦——芥末靠深耕日本这条返佣经济模型真正成立的赛道活了下来，并且把赚钱逻辑对学生讲透（透明本身就是营销）。要避免：以为这套模式能平移到英港新硕士申请——那里的院校佣金根本覆盖不了高端服务成本，这正是AcademiaOne收费精品路线的护城河所在。
